tax_name: Value Added Tax / الضريبة على القيمة المضافة
legal_ref: VAT Law promulgated by Law No. 67 of 2016 (7 Sep 2016), Art. 3
quote: "يكون السعر العام للضريبة على السلع والخدمات (13%) عن العام المالى 2016/2017، و(14%) اعتبارا من العام المالى 2017/2018، ويخصص (1%) من الضريبة للإنفاق على برامج العدالة الاجتماعية" — the general rate on goods and services is 13% for FY 2016/2017 and 14% from FY 2017/2018 (which begins 1 July 2017); 1% of the tax is earmarked for social-justice programmes
source_title: Financial Regulatory Authority (Egypt) – Law No. 67 of 2016 on VAT, consolidated 'according to the latest amendment' (posted Jan 2025); eta.gov.eg has no direct link to the law text

reduced_rates.scope: machinery and equipment used to produce goods or render services (excluding buses and passenger cars) (Art. 3)

notes: Alongside VAT, a 'table tax' (ضريبة الجدول) applies to listed goods/services (tobacco, alcohol, petroleum products, etc.) at specific or ad-valorem rates. Egypt's fiscal year starts 1 July, so 14% applies from 1 July 2017. Registration threshold EGP 500,000 annual turnover (Art. 16). Law No. 157 of 2025 (in force 18 July 2025) amended the VAT law: per secondary reports, construction/contracting services moved from 5% to the general 14% rate, VAT extended to crude oil and certain advertising services, and table-tax changes for cigarettes/alcohol and administrative buildings; further Ministerial Decrees 417 and 418 of 2025.
unverified: Changes made by Law No. 157 of 2025 were not read in an official text (consolidated FRA PDF predates it); in particular whether the 5% machinery rate survives unchanged
Registration threshold EGP 500,000 not re-checked in the fetched PDF
